data.one_liner: Manually add extra hitTest area to widgets without changing their layout size.
data.what_it_does: Provides wrapper widgets like GestureDetectorHitTestWithoutSizeLimit and layout variants such as StackHitTestWithoutSizeLimit to expand the touch target area beyond the visual bounds of a widget without modifying its layout size.
use_when: You need to make a small icon button easier to tap by increasing its hit test area.
A touch target needs to extend outside of its parent widget bounds.
avoid_when: You want to actually resize the widget and its layout bounds rather than just the hit test area.
strengths: Does not alter widget size or layout.
Provides debugging colors to visualize extra hit test areas.
Supports multiple layout and listener widget variants.
weaknesses: Requires using specific custom wrapper widgets instead of standard Flutter widgets.
